San Mateo County 使用 SMC Alert；Santa Clar: San Mateo County uses SMC Alert; Santa Clara County uses AlertSCC. Distinguish city and county names.
Marin County 使用 AlertMarin；北湾其他县另查当地入口。注: Marin County uses AlertMarin; check local portals for other North Bay counties. Verify your address and contact channels as instructed during registration.
可按需要添加工作或家人所在地点；搬家后删除旧地点、更新电话，确认设置已经保存。注: Add work or family locations as needed. After moving, remove old locations, update phone numbers and confirm your settings are saved. Registration does not guarantee delivery of every alert.
停电与空气质量分别查: Check outages and air quality separately
先看账单确认实际供电单位。PG&E 用户收藏 Outage Center，查看停: Confirm your electricity provider on your bill. PG&E customers can bookmark its Outage Center to check affected areas, update times and restoration estimates, which may change. Santa Clara's Silicon Valley Power and Palo Alto Utilities have separate resources. Use the Air District's air-quality page, distinguishing measurements from forecasts. Spare the Air notices are not a live reading for your block.
用现有用品开始，约好联系办法: Start with supplies you own and agree on a contact plan
按 Ready.gov 清单检查饮水、耐储食物、手电、备用电池、充电设备与收音机: Use Ready.gov's checklist to review water, shelf-stable food, flashlights, spare batteries, charging equipment and a radio, then add household and pet necessities. Agree on meeting arrangements and an out-of-area contact, keeping important numbers on paper. Ask building management about notices and exits before connectivity is lost. Check supply expiry dates regularly and adjust outings using current weather, air quality and official instructions.
